# netbox_virtual_circuit (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get Virtual Circuit by CID
data "netbox_virtual_circuit" "example" {
  cid = "VC-0001"
}

// Get Virtual Circuit by ID
data "netbox_virtual_circuit" "example_by_id" {
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cid` (String) At least one of `id` or `cid` must be given.
- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `cid` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `provider_account_id` (Number)
- `provider_network_id` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `tenant_id` (Number)
- `type_id` (Number)
